title: How big is a 1 carat baguette?

hook.text: How big is a 1 carat baguette?

post.youtube_title: How big is a 1 carat baguette?
post.caption:
A 1 carat baguette measures about 8.0 by 4.0 millimeters. A 2 carat baguette covers 31% of the width of a size 6 finger.

Baguette diamond size chart: https://www.heygema.com/en/gem-size/baguette-diamond-size-chart?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=gem_size_shorts
